description: We thought we were safe coming back to the Adrian Griffiths four for a quick blast, but we were way off. First there was the failure of the weather to adhere to the forecast results, leading to yet another white out on the tally this year. Then, there was the questionable decision to straight-arm absolutely everything. We had to call this one after the first summit. It ended up being seriously worth it, given it led to a deathly mess-up at Monteiths with the full gang. Maybe one day this year we'll be back with the rhythm.
